b1l01-class-list.description: A class list on a sheet of paper: three names, each with a country

b1l01-front-1.description: The teacher: a woman with a black bob and blue cardigan stands at the board with a textbook

b1l01-front-2.description: A new female student: Youmei, with a backpack, stands at the board and waves

b1l01-front-3.description: A new male student: a young man with a backpack stands at the board and waves

b1l01-greeting-1.description: Morning: the sun is rising and the clock shows eight; Yiwen waves to Zhongming at the school gate

b1l01-greeting-2.description: Afternoon: the sun is high and the clock shows two; Yiwen waves to Zhongming at the school gate

b1l01-greeting-3.description: Night: the sky is dark with a moon and the clock shows nine; Yiwen and Zhongming wave goodbye at the school gate as they head home

b1l01-intro-card.description: Jiale's handwritten self-introduction card pinned on a classroom board

b1l01-mrs-wang-1.description: Tired: Mrs. Wang slumps at her desk, yawning with heavy eyes; the desk is clear

b1l01-mrs-wang-2.description: Busy: Mrs. Wang talks on the phone and writes fast behind tall piles of papers

b1l01-mrs-wang-3.description: Relaxed: Mrs. Wang leans back in her chair, smiling calmly; the desk is clear

b1l01-snack-1.description: Fruit: a bowl of cut fruit on the table

b1l01-snack-2.description: Tea: a cup of hot tea on the table

b1l01-snack-3.description: Bubble milk tea: a cup of bubble milk tea on the table

b1l01-tea-stand.description: On a sunny afternoon at an outdoor bubble-tea stand: Youmei holds a cup of bubble milk tea that Yiwen has just given her, Yiwen's hands are empty, and Zhongming, next to them, holds a glass of water.

b1l02-classroom.description: A classroom at twelve noon: the teacher waves goodbye, Zhongming yawns at his desk, and Youmei holds her lunch box

b1l02-cook-2.description: A child cooks at the stove

b1l02-home-1.description: Eating: Zhongming eats at the table

b1l02-home-3.description: Cooking: Zhongming cooks at the stove

b1l02-meal-1.description: Morning: Youmei eats at the table as the sun rises outside the window

b1l02-meal-2.description: Night: Youmei eats at the table, with the moon outside the window

b1l02-meal-3.description: Noon: Youmei eats at the table, with the sun high outside the window

b1l03-clothes-1.description: One in white, one in red: Yiwen (the girl) wears white, Zhongming (the boy) wears red

b1l03-clothes-2.description: Both in red: Yiwen and Zhongming both wear red

b1l03-clothes-3.description: One in red, one in white: Yiwen (the girl) wears red, Zhongming (the boy) wears white

b1l03-flowers-1.description: One white, two red: a vase with one white flower and two red flowers

b1l03-flowers-2.description: Two white, one red: a vase with two white flowers and one red flower

b1l03-flowers-3.description: All three red: a vase with three red flowers

b1l03-gift-shop.description: Yiwen holds up a book and Zhongming holds up a pen in a small gift shop with books, flowers, red and white pens, red and white tops and small cakes

b1l03-give-1.description: Book from Yiwen to Zhongming: Yiwen (the girl) hands Zhongming a book

b1l03-give-2.description: Book from Zhongming to Yiwen: Zhongming (the boy) hands Yiwen a book

b1l03-give-3.description: Flowers from Yiwen to Zhongming: Yiwen (the girl) hands Zhongming some flowers

b1l03-invite.description: A birthday invitation card from Youmei with the date, the day, the time and what there will be to eat

b1l03-prices.description: A price board at a gift stand: small pencils, Chinese books, English books, flowers and cakes, each with its price

b1l05-hide-1.description: The boy is under the table: the boy hides under the table, and the girl stands next to it

b1l05-hide-2.description: The girl is under the table: the girl hides under the table, and the boy stands next to it

b1l05-hide-3.description: Both under the table: the boy and the girl hide under the table together

b1l05-house-1.description: Two dogs: two dogs sit on the grass in front of the house

b1l05-house-2.description: Two cats: two cats sit on the grass in front of the house

b1l05-house-3.description: A cat and a dog: one cat and one dog sit on the grass in front of the house

b1l05-house-ad.description: A house-for-rent notice pinned on a board

b1l05-living-room.description: A sunny living room seen from behind the TV: the back of a low TV is at the bottom middle of the picture, its screen turned toward the sofa. An older sister sits alone in the middle of the sofa facing us, watching TV, with empty seats on both sides of her. The sofa stands against the back wall. Her little brother sits on the rug one step right in front of her, in the middle, between her and the TV, with his back to her; he is watching TV too. A dog sleeps under a table with two books on top. A cat lies in the sun by the big window. There is no bird.

b1l05-room-1.description: A bed: a bed stands under the window

b1l05-room-2.description: A sofa: a sofa stands under the window

b1l05-room-3.description: A TV: a TV on a low cabinet stands under the window

b1l05-wallet-1.description: On the sofa: a brown wallet lies on the sofa seat

b1l05-wallet-2.description: Under the sofa: a brown wallet lies on the floor under the sofa

b1l05-wallet-3.description: Next to the sofa: a brown wallet lies on the floor beside the sofa

b1l06-ball-1.description: Basketball: the young man bounces a basketball on the sports field

b1l06-ball-2.description: Soccer: the young man kicks a soccer ball on the sports field

b1l06-ball-3.description: Baseball: the young man swings a bat at a baseball on the sports field

b1l06-beach.description: A sunny beach with green mountains behind: a girl swims in the sea, a young boy runs fast along the sand, two friends kick a soccer ball, two bikes stand by the path, and many people are on the beach.

b1l06-beach-sign.description: A sign at the beach: what you may and may not do there, with the swimming hours

b1l06-games.description: A school poster listing three sports matches with their days and times

b1l06-hobby-1.description: Singing: the young woman sings with her hand on her chest, music notes around her

b1l06-hobby-2.description: Dancing: the young woman dances with her arms up, mid-step

b1l06-hobby-3.description: Drawing: the young woman sits at the table drawing a picture of a flower

b1l06-outing-1.description: Mountain: the two friends stand on a mountain path looking at the view

b1l06-outing-2.description: Movie theater: the two friends sit in a movie theater in front of the big screen

b1l06-outing-3.description: Beach: the two friends stand on the sand at the beach by the sea

b1l06-race-1.description: Sister ahead: the younger sister runs fast, far ahead of her older brother, who jogs slowly behind

b1l06-race-2.description: Brother ahead: the older brother runs fast, far ahead of his younger sister, who jogs slowly behind

b1l06-race-3.description: Side by side: the brother and sister both run fast, level with each other

b1l07-airport-ways.description: A hotel lobby sign comparing three ways to get to the airport: minutes and price for the MRT, the bus and a taxi

b1l07-check-1.description: Paper map: he looks at a big paper map

b1l07-check-2.description: Phone: he looks at a map on his phone

b1l07-check-3.description: Watch: he looks at his wristwatch

b1l07-corner-1.description: Post office next to the hotel: green shop front, a green and a red mailbox outside

b1l07-corner-2.description: Supermarket next to the hotel: shopping carts outside, fruit and food on shelves inside

b1l07-corner-3.description: Café next to the hotel: small tables outside with coffee cups

b1l07-line-1.description: Red line: an MRT train with a red stripe and a red round marker on the platform pillar

b1l07-line-2.description: Green line: an MRT train with a green stripe and a green round marker on the platform pillar

b1l07-line-3.description: Blue line: an MRT train with a blue stripe and a blue round marker on the platform pillar

b1l07-nearby.description: A signboard at the school gate listing four nearby places and how many minutes each one is on foot

b1l07-ride-1.description: Walking: she walks along the street, no bus or taxi

b1l07-ride-2.description: Bus: she gets on a city bus

b1l07-ride-3.description: Taxi: she gets into a yellow taxi

b1l07-street.description: A city street in the daytime: a big, smart hotel with a small yellow taxi parked in front of its entrance, the driver sitting inside at the wheel, waiting (nobody stands outside or behind the taxi); right next to the hotel, a post office with a green front and a green mailbox; a blue bus at a bus stop a little way down the street; Youmei and Yuanzhen stand at the hotel entrance, just arrived, Yuanzhen holding a phone that shows a map.

b1l08-brother-1.description: Tall and thin: the young man is slim, and his head almost reaches the top of the door

b1l08-brother-2.description: Short and thin: the young man is slim, and his head is far below the top of the door

b1l08-brother-3.description: Tall and fat: the young man is round and heavy, and his head almost reaches the top of the door

b1l08-clothes-1.description: A skirt: one black skirt laid flat on the shop counter

b1l08-clothes-2.description: Pants: one pair of black pants laid flat on the shop counter

b1l08-clothes-3.description: Shoes: one pair of black shoes on the shop counter

b1l08-floors.description: A department store floor guide by the elevator. One floor per row, from 5樓 at the top down to 1樓: each row starts with the floor number, then what is sold on that floor. The opening hours are at the bottom

b1l08-purse-1.description: New black purse: a shiny new black purse on the table

b1l08-purse-2.description: Old black purse: the same black purse, still black but worn, with scuffed corners and a small patch

b1l08-purse-3.description: New yellow purse: a shiny new yellow purse on the table

b1l08-reader-1.description: A young man: a young man with short black hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf

b1l08-reader-2.description: An old man: an old man with grey hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf

b1l08-reader-3.description: A young woman: a young woman with long hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf

b1l08-shoe-poster.description: A price poster in a shoe shop window, with a black shoe, a white shoe and a pair of socks, each with its price

b1l08-store.description: A department store clothing floor: Yiwen holds a long blue skirt up in front of a mirror while Yuanzhen smiles and gives a thumbs-up. Behind them are a rack of red, yellow, white and green skirts (none of them blue or black) and an open elevator. No bags, purses or phones are in the picture.

b1l09-books-1.description: The boy has a tall stack of books; the girl has one book

b1l09-books-2.description: The girl has a tall stack of books; the boy has one book

b1l09-books-3.description: The boy and the girl have one book each

b1l09-brush-1.description: Between: the brush lies on the desk between the book and the cup

b1l09-brush-2.description: On the book: the brush lies on top of the book

b1l09-brush-3.description: In the cup: the brush stands in the cup

b1l09-calligraphy.description: A calligraphy class in a classroom with a clean blackboard: at the front the teacher writes with a big writing brush to show the class, while a boy and a girl sit at their desks with brushes, ink and white paper and watch her before they practice.

b1l09-doing-1.description: Calligraphy: she writes on white paper with a writing brush

b1l09-doing-2.description: Homework: she writes in a notebook with a pencil

b1l09-doing-3.description: Reading: she reads a book, with no pencil or brush in her hand

b1l09-exchange.description: A small card pinned to a school notice board

b1l09-notice.description: A notice taped to a classroom door

b1l09-teacher-1.description: Across: the teacher sits across the desk from the boy, facing him, watching him write in his notebook

b1l09-teacher-2.description: Beside: the teacher sits right next to the boy, side by side, watching him write in his notebook

b1l09-teacher-3.description: Behind: the teacher stands squarely behind the boy's chair, both hands on the chair back, looking down over his head, watching him write

b1l10-hours.description: A sign by a hospital door with its opening hours

b1l10-hurt-1.description: Head: the young man presses both hands flat on his forehead; both ears are uncovered

b1l10-hurt-2.description: Belly: the young man holds his belly with both hands

b1l10-hurt-3.description: Ear: the young man cups one hand over one ear; his other hand rests on his knee

b1l10-masks-1.description: Only the boy in a mask: two students with school backpacks; the boy wears a face mask, the girl does not

b1l10-masks-2.description: Only the girl in a mask: two students with school backpacks; the girl wears a face mask, the boy does not

b1l10-masks-3.description: Both in masks: two students with school backpacks; the boy and the girl both wear face masks

b1l10-notice.description: A notice on a classroom notice board about colds

b1l10-waiting-room.description: A clinic waiting room: a worried mother holds her small son, who holds his belly; a young man in a face mask and glasses stands away from the desk, bent a little forward, coughing (small cough lines at his mask) with one hand flat on his chest and the other arm at his side, sleeves pushed up, both bare wrists in plain view; a doctor sits at the desk with a glass of water on it. Only the young man wears a mask: the mother, the boy and the doctor wear none. Nobody wears a watch.

b1l10-wash-1.description: Washing his hands: the little boy rubs soapy hands under the tap; his face and hair are dry

b1l10-wash-2.description: Washing his face: the little boy splashes water on his face; his hair is dry

b1l10-wash-3.description: Washing his hair: the little boy has shampoo foam in his hair; his face is dry

b1l10-with-1.description: With her mother: the young woman stands at the hospital door next to her mother

b1l10-with-2.description: With her father: the young woman stands at the hospital door next to her father

b1l10-with-3.description: With her little brother: the young woman stands at the hospital door next to a small boy
